summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Marketing Agency website - all 10 sections render correctly, backend APIs working, contact form integration successful, mobile responsiveness verified

design_issues.issue: Process section shows 8 timeline steps instead of expected 4 - likely counting both desktop and mobile versions

Navbar sticky positioning with glass effect working
Navbar hamburger menu works on mobile viewport
Navbar CTA 'Book a Free Call' button visible and functional
Nav links scroll smoothly to sections
Hero section has all required elements (headline, subheadline, CTAs, trust badges)
Services section shows 6 cards in grid layout
Results section has dark blue background with 4 stat boxes
Portfolio section has 6 project cards with hover overlay functionality
Testimonials carousel with working prev/next buttons
Why Choose Us has 4 feature blocks on dark blue background
Contact form has all required fields (Name, Email, Phone, Service Interest dropdown, Message)
Contact form POST /api/contact successfully stores data in MongoDB
GET /api/contact returns stored submissions correctly
Footer has 3 columns with logo, quick links, services
Active section highlighting in navbar on scroll working
All placeholder text uses correct [ADD ...] format
Contact form validation working for required fields
Contact form success/error states working properly
Mobile responsiveness working correctly
Backend API validation working (422 errors for missing required fields)
Full frontend-to-backend integration working
